37:21 · 037 As-Saffat

هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

Word in this verse: ٱلْفَصْلِ — (of) Judgment

English (Sahih International): [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

English (Yusuf Ali): (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): (کہا جائے گا کہ ہاں) فیصلے کا دن جس کو تم جھوٹ سمجھتے تھے یہی ہے

38:20 · 038 Sad

وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ

Word in this verse: وَفَصْلَ — and decisive

English (Sahih International): And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

English (Yusuf Ali): We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment in speech and decision.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور ہم نے ان کی بادشاہی کو مستحکم کیا اور ان کو حکمت عطا کی اور (خصومت کی) بات کا فیصلہ (سکھایا)

42:21 · 042 Ash-Shuraa

أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Word in this verse: ٱلْفَصْلِ — decisive

English (Sahih International): Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.

English (Yusuf Ali): What! have they partners (in godhead), who have established for them some religion without the permission of Allah? Had it not been for the Decree of Judgment, the matter would have been decided between them (at once). But verily the Wrong-doers will have a grievous Penalty.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): کیا ان کے وہ شریک ہیں جنہوں نے ان کے لئے ایسا دین مقرر کیا ہے جس کا خدا نے حکم نہیں دیا۔ اور اگر فیصلے (کے دن) کا وعدہ نہ ہوتا تو ان میں فیصلہ کردیا جاتا اور جو ظالم ہیں ان کے لئے درد دینے والا عذاب ہے

44:40 · 044 Ad-Dukhan

إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

Word in this verse: ٱلْفَصْلِ — (the) Day of Judgment

English (Sahih International): Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

English (Yusuf Ali): Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): کچھ شک نہیں کہ فیصلے کا دن ان سب (کے اُٹھنے) کا وقت ہے

77:13 · 077 Al-Mursalat

لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ

Word in this verse: ٱلْفَصْلِ — (of) Judgment

English (Sahih International): For the Day of Judgement.

English (Yusuf Ali): For the Day of Sorting out.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): فیصلے کے دن کے لئے

Open on Quran.com

77:14 · 077 Al-Mursalat

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ

Word in this verse: ٱلْفَصْلِ — (of) the Judgment

English (Sahih International): And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

English (Yusuf Ali): And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور تمہیں کیا خبر کہ فیصلے کا دن کیا ہے؟

Open on Quran.com

77:38 · 077 Al-Mursalat

هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

Word in this verse: ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ — (of) Judgment

English (Sahih International): This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

English (Yusuf Ali): That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): یہی فیصلے کا دن ہے (جس میں) ہم نے تم کو اور پہلے لوگوں کو جمع کیا ہے

78:17 · 078 An-Naba

إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَـٰتًا

Word in this verse: ٱلْفَصْلِ — (of) the Judgment

English (Sahih International): Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

English (Yusuf Ali): Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): بےشک فیصلہ کا دن مقرر ہے

86:13 · 086 At-Tariq

إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ

Word in this verse: فَصْلٌۭ — decisive

English (Sahih International): Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

English (Yusuf Ali): Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): کہ یہ کلام (حق کو باطل سے) جدا کرنے والا ہے
